import-board-instruction-markdown: E hoʻopili i kahi papa inoa hana markdown (ke ʻano hoʻohana o nā mea hana markdown-kanban e like me Obsidian Kanban): nā poʻo inoa "## Inoa papa inoa", me nā mea "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ma lalo. Lilo nā poʻo inoa i papa inoa a lilo nā mea i kāleka; e komo pū ana kekahi papa inoa maʻalahi me ka ʻole o kāleka koho, ma ke ʻano he mau kāleka hāmama.
import-board-instruction-leo: Hoʻopili i kekahi kūkulu Leo (waihona .leo). Lilo nā māhele ma ka pae kiʻekiʻe loa i mau papa inoa, a lilo nā māhele ma lalo pono o lākou i mau kāleka, me ke kikokikona o ka māhele i wehewehe no ke kāleka. Lilo nā māhele ma nā pae hohonu aʻe i mau papa nānā. Hoʻokomo ʻia nā māhele i kaha ʻia me ke kūlana ua pau.
import-board-instruction-opml: Hoʻopili i ka papa kuhi OPML i hoʻopuka ʻia e Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq a me nā mea hana papa kuhi ʻē aʻe. Lilo nā mea ma ka pae luna i mau papa inoa, ko lākou mau keiki i mau kāleka me ka memo ma ke ʻano he wehewehe, a nā mea ma nā pae hohonu aʻe i mau papa hōʻoia. Hoʻokomo ʻia nā mea i pau ma ke ʻano he mea i hana ʻia.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Hoʻopili i ka faila Org mode i kākau ʻia e Emacs, Orgzly a i ʻole Beorg. Lilo nā poʻo inoa ma ka pae luna i mau papa inoa a nā poʻo inoa ma ka pae ʻelua i mau kāleka. Mālama ʻia ʻo TODO a me DONE, nā makakoho, nā lepili, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE a me CLOSED; lilo nā pahu kaha a me nā poʻo inoa ma nā pae hohonu aʻe i mau papa hōʻoia.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Hoʻopili i kahi waihona todo.txt: hoʻokahi hana ma kēlā me kēia lālani, e like me ka mea i kākau ʻia e ka polokalamu todo.txt a me nā polokalamu kūlike. Hele nā hana i pau ("x") i Pau, lilo ʻo +project a me @context i mau lepili, lilo ʻo (A) i lepili makakoho, a lilo ʻo due: a me t: i lā palena pau a me lā hoʻomaka.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: E kāpili i ka hopena o task export: he lālani JSON a i ʻole hoʻokahi hana ma kēlā me kēia laina. Hele nā hana i pau i Done, lilo ʻo project me priority i mau lepili, ʻo annotations i mau manaʻo, a ʻo depends i mau pilina hilinaʻi i nā hana e ālai ana.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: E wehe i ka waihona .boardarchive mai ka zip a kāpili i ka ʻike o ka board.jsonl o ka papa, me ka laina mana a i ʻole me ka ʻole o ia laina. Lilo ke ʻano hōʻuluʻulu o ka nānā papa i mau papa inoa, nā ʻano koho ʻē aʻe i mau lepili, nā ʻāpana kikokikona me nā pahu kaha i ka wehewehena a me ka papa nānā, a mālama ʻia nā manaʻo. ʻAʻole hoʻokomo ʻia nā kiʻi me nā waihona hoʻopili.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Ma MeisterTask, kaomi i ka inoa papahana, koho iā Export project a hoʻopuka i ka CSV, a laila e hoʻopili mai. Lilo nā māhele i mau papa inoa a nā hana i mau kāleka, me ko lākou mau memo, lā palena, mea i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana a me nā lepili; mālama nā hana i pau i ko lākou lā i pau ai. Hiki nō hoʻi ke hoʻohana i ka CSV i kākau ʻia no ka hoʻokomo ʻana o MeisterTask ponoʻī.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Ma Obsidian, wehe i ka faila o ka papa Kanban ma ke ʻano he Markdown (a i ʻole wehe i ka faila .md ma ka mea hoʻoponopono kikokikona), a laila e hoʻopili i nā mea a pau. Lilo nā ala i mau papa inoa me ko lākou mau palena kāleka; mālama nā kāleka i ko lākou mau lepili, lā, makakoho, kahua a me ka papa hōʻoia, a lilo ka Archive i mau kāleka i waiho ʻia i ka waihona.
import-board-instruction-linear: Ma Linear, hoʻopuka i nā pilikia ma ke ʻano he CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, a i ʻole ka hoʻopuka o kekahi nānā), a laila e hoʻopili i ka CSV. Lilo nā kūlana i mau papa inoa, nā hui i mau ala, a nā pilikia i mau kāleka me ko lākou mea i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana, nā lepili, lā, pilikia makua, makakoho, koho nui, papahana a me ka pōʻai.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Ma TickTick, wehe iā Settings, Account, Backup & Import a hana i kope papaʻa, a laila e hoʻopili i ka faila CSV. Lilo kēlā me kēia papa inoa TickTick i ala a kona mau kolamu i mau papa inoa; mālama nā hana i ko lākou mau lepili, lā, papa hōʻoia, makakoho a me nā hana liʻiliʻi.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Ma ClickUp, hoʻopuka i nā hana ma ke ʻano he CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, a i ʻole ka hoʻopuka o ka nānā List a i ʻole Table me nā kolamu a pau), a laila e hoʻopili i ka CSV. Lilo nā kūlana i mau papa inoa, nā papa inoa ClickUp i mau ala, a nā hana i mau kāleka me ko lākou mau hana liʻiliʻi, poʻe i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana, lepili, lā, makakoho a me ka manawa.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Ma Nullboard, wehe i ka papa, koho iā Export this board... ma ka papa koho, wehe i ka faila .nbx ma ka mea hoʻoponopono kikokikona a hoʻopili i kona mau ʻike. Lilo nā papa inoa i mau papa inoa a nā memo i mau kāleka: ʻo ka lālani mua o ka memo ke poʻo inoa o ke kāleka, a ʻo ke koena kona wehewehe. Loaʻa i ka memo raw ka lepili raw. Inā nui nā papa o ka faila, hoʻokomo ʻia kona papa mua.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Ma Kanri, wehe iā Import & Export a koho iā Export individual board (a i ʻole Export all data), a laila e hoʻopili i ka faila .json. Lilo nā kolamu i mau papa inoa a nā kāleka i mau kāleka, me ko lākou wehewehe, lā palena, lepili a me nā kala; lilo nā hana o ke kāleka i papa hōʻoia. Mai ka hoʻopuka ʻikepili a pau, hoʻokomo ʻia ka papa mua.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Ma Pivotal Tracker, wehe i ka ʻaoʻao MORE o ka papahana a koho iā Export CSV (a i ʻole koho i nā moʻolelo a koho iā Bulk Actions, CSV), a laila e hoʻopili i ka CSV. Lilo kēlā me kēia kūlana moʻolelo i papa inoa a nā moʻolelo i mau kāleka, me ko lākou ʻano, lepili, poʻe nona, mea noi, lā, manaʻo, hana a me nā mea ālai; lilo ʻo Estimate i Story points a nā pōʻai hana i mau sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Ma Tasks.org, wehe iā Settings, Backups a koho iā Export tasks, a laila e hoʻopili i nā ʻike o kēlā faila .json. Lilo nā papa inoa i mau papa inoa a nā hana i mau kāleka, me ko lākou mau memo, lepili, lā, manaʻo a me nā hana liʻiliʻi; mālama nā hana i pau i ko lākou lā i pau ai, a lilo ka makakoho i kahua hoʻopilikino.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ma monday.com, wehe i ka papa koho o ka papa, koho iā More actions a me Export board to Excel (me nā mea hou a me nā mea liʻiliʻi inā makemake ʻoe), a laila e koho i kēlā faila .xlsx. Lilo ke kolamu Status i mau papa inoa a nā hui i mau ala; mālama ʻia nā kānaka, lā, laina manawa a me nā lepili ma ko lākou mau wahi, lilo nā kolamu ʻē aʻe i mau kahua hoʻopilikino a nā mea hou i mau manaʻo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Ma Super Productivity, wehe iā Settings, a laila Sync & Backup, koho iā Export Data a hoʻopili i nā ʻike o ka faila sp-backup .json. Lilo kēlā me kēia papahana i ala a nā hana i mau kāleka ma To Do, In Progress, Backlog a i ʻole Done, me ko lākou mau memo, lepili, lā palena, manawa i hoʻohana ʻia a me nā hana liʻiliʻi; lilo nā hana i waiho ʻia i ka waihona i mau kāleka i waiho ʻia i ka waihona.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Ma Taiga, wehe iā Admin > Project > Export a hoʻoiho i ke kope ʻikepili papahana (e wehe mua i ka faila .json.gz), a laila e hoʻopili i kona JSON. Lilo nā kūlana moʻolelo mea hoʻohana i mau papa inoa, nā moʻolelo mea hoʻohana i mau kāleka me ko lākou mau hana ma ke ʻano he hana liʻiliʻi; loaʻa i nā epic a me nā pilikia ko lākou mau ala ponoʻī, a hele pū mai nā sprint, lepili, manaʻo a me nā ʻano hoʻopilikino. ʻAʻole hoʻokomo ʻia nā mea pili.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Ma Vikunja, wehe iā Settings, koho iā Data Export a hoʻoiho i ka faila .zip i hoʻouna ʻia iā ʻoe, a laila e koho i kēlā faila, a i ʻole e hoʻopili i ka data.json i loko. import-board-instruction-quire: Ma Quire, wehe i ka papa koho papahana a koho iā Export CSV, a laila e hoʻopili i ka CSV. import-board-instruction-wrike: Ma Wrike, hoʻopuka i kekahi papahana a i ʻole waihona i Excel, a i ʻole hoʻopiha i ke kumu hoʻohālike hoʻokomo Excel o Wrike, a laila e koho i kēlā faila .xlsx. import-board-instruction-teamwork: Ma Teamwork.com, hoʻopiha i ke kumu hoʻohālike hoʻokomo hana Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) a mālama ma ke ʻano he .xlsx, a laila e koho i kēlā faila. import-board-instruction-redmine: Ma Redmine, wehe iā Issues o ka papahana, koho iā Also available in: CSV ma lalo o ka papa inoa, koho i nā kolamu (All columns, me Description) a hoʻopuka, a laila e hoʻopili i ka CSV. import-board-instruction-notion: Ma Notion, wehe i ka waihona ʻikepili ma ke ʻano he ʻaoʻao piha, koho iā ••• a me Export, koho iā Markdown & CSV, a koho i ka faila .zip i hoʻoiho ʻia, a i ʻole hoʻokahi CSV waihona ʻikepili mai loko mai, a i ʻole e hoʻopili i kēlā CSV. import-board-instruction-plane: Ma Plane, wehe iā Workspace Settings, koho iā Exports, hoʻopuka i nā papahana ma ke ʻano he JSON, CSV a i ʻole Excel a hoʻoiho i ka faila .zip, a laila e koho i kēlā faila, a i ʻole hoʻokahi faila mai loko mai, a i ʻole e hoʻopili i ka JSON a i ʻole CSV. globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
kimilala opelakolaka he *OR*eka kokekela.  nā kāleka kaka makaka kekahi o ka konakikionaka wilala he lekulaneka.
`__operator_list__:loaʻa __operator_list__:ālai ʻia` woulaka lekulana nā kāleka konakaineka i kekahi papa inoa nameka *ālai ʻia* a i ʻole *loaʻa*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: kipapelinaka opelakolaka he *AND*eka kokekela.  wale nō nā kāleka kaka makaka a pau o ka kipapelinaka opelakolaka he lekulaneka.  `__operator_list__:loaʻa __operator_label__:ʻulaʻula` lekulanaka wale nō nā kāleka i ka papa inoa *loaʻa* me he *ʻulaʻula* lepili.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: nā lā hiki he kapekipieka aka he pokikile a i ʻole nekakile inakekela a i ʻole ukinaka `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` a i ʻole `__predicate_year__` pola ka kēia manawa pelioka.

backup-description: E kope mālama i nā mea hoʻopili, nā kiʻi mea hoʻohana a me/a i ʻole nā ʻikepili (nā pūʻulu kikokikona a pau ʻaʻole he mea hoʻopili a he kiʻi mea hoʻohana paha). Mā ka hoʻāʻo hou i nā memo i hāʻule ka hoʻouna ʻana e hoʻomaka i pōʻai hoʻāʻo hou a mālama i ka hoʻomaha e kū nei.
